title: Alpha Flight #12 Marvel July 1984 Death of Guardian Double-Sized John Byrne Key
conditionDescription: Bright cover with light handling wear; small creases near the spine at the top left. See photos.
descriptionText:
Alpha Flight #12 (July 1984), Marvel Comics - Special Double-Sized Issue, "And one shall surely die!" Death of Guardian (James Hudson). Story, art and cover by John Byrne. Direct edition, $1.00 cover price.

Back cover: Parker Brothers Frogger / Popeye / Q*bert Atari computer games ad.

Condition: bright cover with light handling wear; small creases near the spine at the top left (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
